scope: Local synthetic data only; no production/staging/backup changes. No deployment or automatic retention enabled.

method.environment: Node v24.15.0; PostgreSQL 16 container, 1 CPU/768 MiB on a shared host; loopback; API pool 8/concurrency 4. No other task DB work during timed cohorts.
method.http: Predefined ABBA: prior integrated performance branch, candidate, candidate, prior. Same benchmark harness; 100 warm requests/route/profile, 1 fresh-process request/route/profile, 1200 seeded reports, 297 scope lines, summary point view. Cache flag enabled on both revisions. Source archives use identical dependencies.
method.pool: 11 positive-phase interval buckets, including warmup before sampler reset; no-session/no-module requests validated separately. Earlier 10-bucket series omitted warmup and are not directly comparable as aggregate fractions. No >5s waiting run observed in final cohorts.
method.service: 5 paired calculations/mode/shape/cohort, alternating reference/candidate. ANALYZE before timing for both sources; warm database pages. Initial standardized order sparse,dense; predefined repeat dense,sparse. Boot/module imports excluded. 60 complete DTO pairs equal across four cohorts. Diagnostic prototypes are excluded from acceptance.
method.cold: Only 1 HTTP cold sample/route/profile/cohort, no cold p95. Local service cold reduction is not HTTP cold acceptance.
method.limitations: Shared host, synthetic scale, warm PostgreSQL pages. No TLS/proxy/browser/network/production load/24h or 7-day observations. No uniform latency improvement claim.

serviceCohorts.method: Local paired uncached service calculations on PostgreSQL with warm database pages; not HTTP latency. Timings exclude process boot and module imports. Fresh Node/Prisma processes for every cold sample. After-session performs a SELECT, not HTTP authentication. Prisma operation profiles include mapping; sqlQueries capture pg pool calls and replay SELECTs with EXPLAIN ANALYZE after the calculation. Pool call durations overlap and include queue/event-loop delays. Initialization diagnostics run in separate processes and do not warm timed samples. Result bytes are JSON sizes, not network traffic.
serviceCohorts.cpuMethod: process.cpuUsage delta around the calculation only, before EXPLAIN replay; includes Node/Prisma CPU, excludes PostgreSQL, module imports and process boot. CPU and wall time are separate observations.
